notes:
Link as Same Run: right-click a pipe run on the tender drawing, choose Same Run > Link as Same Run, then click the same run on the construction drawing. Both runs take one reference, shown as a tag on each drawing, and picking one highlights the other. Run Reference… sets your own reference, such as the tender schedule's. A run with a reference on one drawing only is listed as Tender only or Construction only.
Takeoff > Tender and Construction… lists every reference with its length on tender, on construction and the difference, with totals and Copy Table for Excel.
Pages > right-click > Drawing Issue sets a drawing as Tender or Construction.
Claude can link and compare runs with its new same_run tool.
